scope: Independent source/contract review and actual synthetic-only regression of the separate first-failing ZIP-header diagnostic. No source object, original private cache or network read; only public source identities and source-code files used.
source_review: The classifier retains original terminal-record checks, count bound, early ZipFile central parsing and local-offset ordering before member/header predicates. It emits one closed first-failure category and the matching legacy ZIP reason.

Completed header classification, including HEADER_PROFILE_ACCEPTED, remains BLOCKED_SCHEMA. Failures of provenance, source, argument or output guards are separately BLOCKED_GUARD and never approve schema or scientific use.

The bridge pins the original canonical capture digest, original commit, five legacy digests, fixed inventory and object SHA-256, then applies old size/MD5/SHA verification to the same bounded object buffer. New implementation identity is separate; no old receipt/object is modified.

Production requires the exact tracked script and worktree/index/HEAD agreement for new files plus unchanged old files before cache access. Fixed run slots cannot override source/object/URL/output paths.
No member payload opening, decompression or XML path appears in the classifier. Metadata/name parsing is explicit exposure, and partial raw-source reads remain unknown rather than false.
Counts, fits, splits, source overlap and independence are not promoted by header results or synthetic passes.
independent_regression_scope: Stored and deliberately invalid deflate payloads produce identical header-only acceptance under forbidden decompression/member-open/XML/network entrypoints.
Changing synthetic payload, unsupported-name and member-comment canaries cannot alter any public output beyond the declared closed category; reports contain no canary strings.
Compound failures preserve precedence, including constructor parsing before member predicates and local-offset ordering despite reversed central entries.
Short/truncated inputs, member limits, missing/duplicate/unsafe names, file types, size/offset/local-name/data-bound failures match the unchanged legacy ZIP reason.
A capture receipt reconstructed only from public source identities matches the fixed capture hash; altered commit, object digest and each old file digest fail before any object read.
The exact object SHA is required after the capture bridge; verification failure cannot reach classification, and interrupted source reads retain unknown exposure.
Candidate path, invalid run, changed old digest, staged new-source mismatch and existing symlink output refuse without private input access.
next_gate: Root publishes exact new source and all frozen files, verifies exact-commit CI, then may run the separate actual diagnostic under the existing authorized plan.
change_between_runs: Root identified a clean-checkout portability issue in reviewer-test setup: .cache may not exist. Added parents=True only to REVIEW.mkdir, preserving first test source under first/test_li_v3_zip_diagnostic_review.py. No product source or test assertions changed.
